unit.why: A single narrative about the Yehudi of Przysucha leaving R. Abraham Joshua Heschel of Apt for the Seer of Lublin, who had predicted the coming of someone named Yaakov Yitzhak ben Matil.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי בשם הרה״ק היהודי ז"ל שהיה בראשונה
stories.end_quote: אז שלח הרבי זצ״ל את העלם ממנו
stories.summary_en: The Yehudi, first with the Apter Rav, twice asks leave to travel to the Seer of Lublin. The second time he refuses the meal the Rav insists on and goes anyway. The Seer had said he came into the world only for a man named Yaakov Yitzhak ben Matil, and had honoured a youth of that name for a year. When the Yehudi arrives bearing the same name, the Seer sends the youth away.
